Now, I'm going to select the column "infant_sex". For that, I have to call the package dplyr

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
SexColumn <- Data |> select("infant_sex")
SexColumn[1:5,]
```
[1] "Male" "Male" "Male" "Male" "Male"

To know the number of rows:
```{r}
nrow(SexColumn)
```
[1] 196

next, I want to reorganize and put this column after timepoint

```{r}
Data |> relocate(infant_sex, .after=timepoint) |> head(3)
```
